chapters.title: The Glass Cannon’s Guide to Not Dying
chapters.goal: Artie acquires the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion and begins exploiting the system's loot mechanics in the crypts.
chapters.stakes_shift: From desperate survival to tactical exploitation of the system's physics and drop rates.

bridge.from_prev: Artie escapes Vane but remains a one-hit-kill target.
bridge.to_next: Artie's rapid farming triggers the attention of the Floor Guardian.

sections.title: The Coward's Wardrobe
sections.intent: Artie seeks gear to survive his 1 HP fragility and exploits a quest loophole.
sections.end_condition: Artie steals the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion from a locked starter chest.

scenes.summary: Artie wanders the Oakhaven market looking for defensive gear, but everything is either too expensive or level-locked, leaving him vulnerable.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes standard merchants cannot solve his 1 HP problem.
scenes.location_start: The bustling central square of Oakhaven
scenes.location_end: A row of overpriced armor stalls in the market
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie catches his breath among the crowded market stalls, scanning for armor vendors.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie turns away from the laughing merchant, his empty pockets offering no solutions.

scenes.summary: Fizz points out a 'Starter Quest' loophole involving an allegedly unbreakable display chest meant to teach players about lockpicking.
scenes.outcome: Artie decides to bypass the quest requirements and just break the chest.
scenes.location_start: A row of overpriced armor stalls in the market
scenes.location_end: The crowded plaza in front of the Adventurer's Guild
scenes.transition_in_text: Fizz projects a glowing blue waypoint leading away from the market toward the guild plaza.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie steps up to the heavy display chest, ignoring the warning signs.

scenes.summary: Artie strikes the 'indestructible' lock, triggering a massive critical hit that shatters it, allowing him to loot the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion.
scenes.outcome: Artie steals the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion from a locked starter chest.
scenes.location_start: The crowded plaza in front of the Adventurer's Guild
scenes.location_end: A shadowed alley behind the guild hall
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie raises his rusty dagger and brings it down hard on the indestructible lock.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie wraps the oversized cloak around his shoulders and ducks into a nearby alley before the guards arrive.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie steals the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion from a locked starter chest.

sections.title: Loot Pinata Theory
sections.intent: Artie enters the crypts and discovers how his crits break the loot drop system.
sections.end_condition: Artie clears a room of skeletons, turning them into a mountain of loot.

scenes.summary: Artie enters the Oakhaven Crypts, testing his new Cloak of the Cowardly Lion to sneak past high-level mobs, but accidentally aggros a skeleton.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes the cloak's stealth is flawed but his 100% crit still applies to basic attacks.
scenes.location_start: A shadowed alley behind the guild hall
scenes.location_end: The damp entrance to the Oakhaven Crypts
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie slips out of the shadowed alleyway, following Fizz's glowing waypoint toward the low-level crypts on the edge of town.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie steps on a brittle femur, drawing the glowing red eyes of a skeletal guard.

scenes.summary: Artie panics and throws a random rock at the skeleton, triggering a massive critical hit that shatters it into an absurd amount of loot.
scenes.outcome: Artie discovers that his crits force enemies to drop their entire loot table at once.
scenes.location_start: The damp entrance to the Oakhaven Crypts
scenes.location_end: A small antechamber inside the crypts
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie scrambles backward across the damp stone as the skeleton lunges, grabbing a loose rock from the floor.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie stares at the mountain of gold coins and rare bone fragments burying the shattered skeleton.

scenes.summary: Realizing the exploit, Artie systematically clears the antechamber by throwing pebbles at a horde of skeletons, creating a massive pile of loot.
scenes.outcome: Artie clears a room of skeletons, turning them into a mountain of loot.
scenes.location_start: A small antechamber inside the crypts
scenes.location_end: A small antechamber inside the crypts
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie scoops up a handful of gravel, eyeing the next group of skeletons with a greedy grin.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie sits atop his new hoard, ignoring the deep rumbling echoing from the lower crypt levels.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie clears a room of skeletons, turning them into a mountain of loot.

sections.title: Summoning Trouble
sections.intent: Vane's interference forces Artie to take a massive risk for XP.
sections.end_condition: Artie activates the Boss Trigger left behind by Vane.

scenes.summary: Artie and Fizz investigate the rumbling deeper in the crypts, discovering that Vane has been clearing the lower levels and left behind a high-level Boss Trigger item to farm later.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes Vane is using the crypts as a personal farming ground and spots the Boss Trigger.
scenes.location_start: A small antechamber inside the crypts
scenes.location_end: A massive, circular stone chamber deep in the crypts
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie slides down the mountain of gold coins, following the deep rumbling sound deeper into the dark stone corridor.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie peers around a shattered stone pillar, spotting the glowing Boss Trigger resting on an obsidian pedestal.

scenes.summary: Fizz warns Artie that activating the Boss Trigger will summon a creature far beyond his level, but Artie calculates the massive XP payout and decides the risk is worth it to out-level Vane's threat.
scenes.outcome: Artie decides to steal Vane's boss kill to gain a massive XP boost.
scenes.location_start: A massive, circular stone chamber deep in the crypts
scenes.location_end: A massive, circular stone chamber deep in the crypts
scenes.transition_in_text: Fizz projects a flashing red warning screen over the glowing Boss Trigger, detailing the suicidal level gap.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie dismisses the warning screen with a swipe of his hand, stepping up to the obsidian pedestal.

scenes.summary: Artie ignores Fizz's frantic warnings and slams his hand onto the Boss Trigger, locking the room and initiating the summoning sequence for the Floor Guardian.
scenes.outcome: Artie activates the Boss Trigger left behind by Vane.
scenes.location_start: A massive, circular stone chamber deep in the crypts
scenes.location_end: A massive, circular stone chamber deep in the crypts
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie steps up to the obsidian pedestal, ignoring Fizz's frantic beeping.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie activates the Boss Trigger left behind by Vane.
